title: Scanned Symbol at a Given Position
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration on input word $y$, and let $i$ be one of the $|y|+2$ input-head positions. If the input head of $d$ is at position $i$, then the symbol read by the head is the input-cell value at position $i$.
